cohort: Neonates with clinical signs of ON presenting to Maternal and Child Health units of 6 health care facilities in the Central region of Ghana.
finding: Microbial growth was found in 52.4% of neonates assessed, with Staphylococcus spp. being the most common causative organism (39.2% of positive cultures), and no cases of gonococcus isolated.
mod_finding: Delivery method was a risk factor associated with the development of ON.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was a risk factor for ON
